Design.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/4] The model predicted decision type (self-serving or prosocial) with separate regressors for outcome uncertainty (type of Dictator Game: standard, hidden information), impact uncertainty (Receiver information: uncertain, certain-poor, certain-rich, control), and the interaction between outcome and impact uncertainty.

country.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/5] One potential alternative explanation for our findings is that participants believed that the average MTurk participant was low-income. [/page/7/Text/3] In this study the control condition explicitly mentioned that online participants come from all walks of life, some "are poor (meaning their income is below the poverty threshold) and are very dependent on the money they earn on Prolific to help supplement their income to pay for food and shelter".

info_cost.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/1] a Hidden Information Game, where a self-serving choice led probabilistically to a worse outcome for the Receiver (outcome uncertainty; Fig. 2e) but participants had the chance to reveal the outcome of the self-serving option beforehand at no cost.

Sample.evidence_source: The paper reports overall N for statistical tests (e.g., N=832 for main effects across Studies 1-3, N=417 for comparisons within impact uncertainty conditions), but does not provide specific N for each (Tmt x Ctr) cell or the sum of participants in a specific Tmt vs Ctr comparison.

N_Self_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: The paper discusses proportions of prosocial choices and statistical significance but does not provide raw counts of selfish choices for any specific (Tmt x Ctr) cell.

N_Self_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: The paper discusses proportions of prosocial choices and statistical significance but does not provide raw counts of selfish choices for any specific (Tmt x Ctr) cell.

N_Altr_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: The paper discusses proportions of prosocial choices and statistical significance but does not provide raw counts of altruistic choices for any specific (Tmt x Ctr) cell, nor does it provide the necessary N_Tot_CI_Ctr and N_Self_CI_Ctr to derive it.
